_comment: RL tuning for Math GRPO jobs built from the catalog: optimizer betas (0.9, 0.95), mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb packing, and ZeRO reduce_scatter. Skipped with job_config=. With job_id=, the merged job is not submitted, but the example still reads settings such as the model, batch size and learning rate from it, so keep them matching the attached job. See recipes/README.md, "How an example builds its job", for how this file is merged.
